summary: Round 5 scoped re-test of the 3 round-4 fixes in Dynamo Feed. ALL THREE PASS. (A) SwipeDeck forward nav works: deck-next advances exactly one card per click (fly-off x->480, opacity->0, 0.3s), ArrowRight advances, ArrowLeft goes back and wraps, drag past 110px commits, small drag spring-back returns, rapid double-click during fly-off produces exactly ONE advance (busyRef guard holds), deck-hint hides after first commit, wiggle only plays once on first entry. (B) Peek cards now render with h-full: visible heights ~236px and ~235px, rotations ~-3deg and ~+3deg (matrix 0.99863,+/-0.052336), peek 26px and 46px below the top card's bottom edge -> clearly visible pile. (C) Verdict stamp on /r/marge-reviews-saurav last beat is fully inside review-card bbox on all four sides (verdict.top=53.73 vs card.top=49.55, inset ~4.19px; left/right/bottom all inside). Sanity checks pass. No code changes made.

B_peek_cards.note: Both peek divs clearly tall (h-full), rotated as spec, and bottom edges visibly peek below top card's bottom edge.

C_verdict_stamp_inside_card.note: Previously overhanging 7.45px above card top; now sits 4.19px inside. top-5 (20px) with -rotate-12 fits.

critical_code_review_comments: commit() correctly uses controls.start(...).then(...) as the single advance path. onAnimationComplete handler was removed from the motion.div, so there's no double-advance risk. Verified by rapid double-click producing one advance.
setIndex((v) => v + 1) uses an unbounded counter and relies on itemAt doing modulo count. Works, but counter grows unbounded over long sessions; a modulo at setIndex would be cleaner. Non-blocking.
Peek divs use h-full inside an h-56 relatively positioned container plus translate-y - renders as spec. Works.
ReviewTemplate verdict at right-2 top-5 with -rotate-12 is now inside the card. Works.
Carried-over content issue (not in scope but worth flagging again): src/content/now.json still has REPLACE: placeholders for watch items, now-reading book, and spanish streak take.
action_items: Optional: replace REPLACE: placeholders in src/content/now.json with real content before shipping (carried over from iter 4, not in this round's scope).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 4's three bugs are all resolved in Round 5. now.json watch deck actually has 5 items (show 1, film 1, show 2, film 2, show 3) not 3 - matters when writing loop assertions. commit() single-advance path is controls.start(...).then(setIndex); onAnimationComplete was intentionally removed. Peek divs rely on h-full inside h-56 parent + translate-y to peek. Verdict at right-2 top-5 -rotate-12 is the final geometry.
